description: This file implements a Sentry integration for frame processor metrics, enabling performance monitoring and debugging via Sentry transactions. It manages setup, cleanup, and transaction handling for TTFB and processing metrics, utilizing asyncio for asynchronous operations.

classes.name: SentryMetrics
classes.description: A class extending FrameProcessorMetrics to integrate Sentry monitoring for frame processing and performance metrics.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the SentryMetrics object, setting up internal state and verifying Sentry SDK initialization.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up the Sentry metrics system, creating a background task for handling Sentry transactions.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up Sentry resources, flushes pending transactions, and ensures proper shutdown.

methods.name: start_ttfb_metrics
methods.description: Starts tracking time-to-first-byte metrics and initiates a Sentry transaction if available.

methods.name: stop_ttfb_metrics
methods.description: Stops TTFB metrics tracking and queues the transaction for completion.

methods.name: start_processing_metrics
methods.description: Starts tracking frame processing metrics and initiates a Sentry transaction.

methods.name: stop_processing_metrics
methods.description: Stops processing metrics tracking and queues the transaction for completion.

methods.name: _sentry_task_handler
methods.description: Background task that processes queued Sentry transactions, finishing them in an executor.
